description: This file is a shell script that performs performance testing on Git's object database, measuring the impact of different fsync configurations when adding files, creating commits, and performing other repository operations.

methods.name: populate_files
methods.description: Creates a specified number of unique files within the test repository.

methods.name: setup_repo
methods.description: Initializes a new Git repository, commits initial state, and populates it with files for testing.

methods.name: test_perf_fsync_cfgs
methods.description: Runs performance tests with different fsync configurations and reports timing results.
